=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py: lines 741-744 (the kept-line branch in `_artifact_diagnostic_extract`); the four denylist regexes in `_ARTIFACT_ENV_ASSIGNMENT_RES` (lines 112-117) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Diagnostic lines are retained verbatim when they contain credentials that the four denylist regexes do not catch, such as inline bearer tokens or arbitrary `IDENT=value` pairs.
  WHY: An artifact’s error line can be written to the evidence folder and `render_prompt_section` output with its credential intact.

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Extract only allowlisted diagnostic fields from artifacts before caching them; exclude free-form stderr and environment assignments rather than relying on credential-pattern redaction."
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py — `_artifact_diagnostic_extract` and the `_ARTIFACT_ENV_ASSIGNMENT_RES` denylist
  Evidence of absence: The implementation keeps the full line of every diagnostic match, and its denylist relies on credential-pattern redaction (the env assignment regexes) rather than dropping free-form stderr. Lines that match `_ERROR_LINE_RE` / `_ARTIFACT_ERROR_WORD_RE` / `_EXIT_CODE_RE` retain any free-form text after the match — including inline bearer tokens and arbitrary `IDENT=value` pairs whose identifier is not in the keyword list. The new tests (`test_artifact_extract_drops_environment_assignments`, `test_artifact_extract_keeps_allowlisted_diagnostics`, `test_artifact_extract_bounds_lines_and_line_length`, `test_collected_evidence_never_contains_artifact_assignment_secret`) only exercise the cases the denylist already catches; none of them feed a `::error::bearer …` or `::error::value=secret` line and assert the secret is gone. The header `… environment assignments and free-form text dropped (…)` in `_artifact_diagnostic_extract` is also misleading because the kept diagnostic lines are not "free-form-text-dropped".
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
